description.en:
Sets two brightness-related display flags for one screen, in the display controller's control word (bits 9 and 11 for the top screen, bits 10 and 12 for the bottom screen).
Exactly what each flag changes on screen was not identified. Only screens 0 and 1 are supported: SCREEN_AB (2) does nothing, use CMND_BRIGHT_SWAP_ALL for both screens.
First flag (bit 9 for the top screen, bit 10 for the bottom screen).
Second flag (bit 11 for the top screen, bit 12 for the bottom screen).

1.0 once the flags were set, 0.0 if the screen was not 0 or 1 (or the display controller was missing).
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.
